meta.description: Call accessible chromatin regions from ATAC-seq BAM files using MACS3, MACS2, Genrich, or HMMRATAC. Use when identifying open chromatin from aligned ATAC-seq, choosing between point-source vs HMM peak callers, applying ENCODE-style pseudoreplicate IDR, removing blacklist regions, or fixing 501bp consensus peaks for downstream differential analysis.

scientific_integrity.detail: All reported counts and ratios recomputed independently; untested claims (30M-read HMMRATAC depth, ROSE, whole genome, mm10) are labelled as untested or illustrative

practice_boundaries.detail: Research-only genomics Skill, no clinical conclusions

methodological_ground.detail: Disjoint pseudoreplicates and the ENCODE rescue and self-consistency rule now match encode_task_reproducibility.py; genuine passing and failing libraries give the correct verdicts

code_usability.detail: Script ran to completion in three modes (MACS3 pass, MACS2 pass, MACS3 failing library) and its guards refuse bad inputs

functional_suitability.note: Workflow, script and references agree; ratio rule, pseudoreplicates, install and caller commands verified; description still names 501 bp consensus peaks the Skill does not build

reliability.note: Input, index, sort, chrM, tool and argument guards work; no handling shown for degenerate libraries where IDR itself aborts; one transient I/O failure under load

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is short with routed references; method-reference.md is 20 KB but sectioned

agent_usability.note: Clear workflow, tested Genrich and hmmratac commands, verdict printed to reproducibility.txt; needs two environments and a wrapper or IDR variable

human_usability.note: Consistent single-sample and IDR guidance, decision tables and prompts; long reference file

security.note: Expansions quoted, no credentials or destructive operations; blacklist download has no checksum

maintainability.note: License and provenance kept, tested versions stated accurately; ROSE, HOMER, chromap, whole-genome and mm10 unverified

agent_specific.note: Rich trigger description, ENCODE differences disclosed; description overreaches on consensus peaks and testing covers one chr1 slice of one cell line

inputs.label: ENCODE-style script on GM12878 rep1/rep2 chr1:1-30Mb (passing library, MACS3, bigWig)
inputs.note: Nt=1197 N1=1143 N2=1249 Np=1036, rescue 1.155, self 1.093, PASS; 1,188 blacklist-free conservative peaks; matches the disjoint reference from the initial audit

assertions.text: Script exits 0 and writes per-replicate, pooled, six pseudoreplicate, four IDR, plot, conservative and bigWig outputs
assertions.note: All present; rep1 4,803, rep2 4,366, pooled 4,310 peaks; four IDR PNGs (true_reps plot inspected, legible)

assertions.text: Reported Nt, N1, N2, Np equal an independent recount of IDR rows with score >= 540 and the verdict follows the ENCODE rule
assertions.note: Recount 1197/1143/1249/1036 identical; every row score >= 540; rescue 1.155 and self 1.093 both <= 2 give PASS

assertions.text: Pseudoreplicate halves are disjoint and keep pairs together (rep1 re-split)
assertions.note: 524,024 read names, 0 shared, union equals all; every name appears twice in each half where present

assertions.text: Conservative set is 10-column narrowPeak, has no blacklist overlap and agrees with ENCODE IDR peaks
assertions.note: 1,188 rows, 0 overlaps with the v2 blacklist, 1,059 overlap ENCODE ENCFF346CZA; 2,194 of 2,566 slice ENCODE peaks recovered

assertions.text: pooled.bw is a valid bigWig whose signal matches the pooled bedGraph
assertions.note: Header readback: version 4, basesCovered 29,998,866, max 7,458.77, mean 5.0, identical to the bedGraph

inputs.label: Genuinely failing library (rep2 = 6% subsample), ratio-logic unit cases, MACS=macs2 mode
inputs.note: Failing library gives Nt=495 N1=1143 N2=233 Np=1680, rescue 3.394, self 4.906, FAIL; MACS2 mode byte-identical to MACS3; first attempt hit a transient drvfs read error under 3 concurrent runs

assertions.text: A poorly reproducible library is reported FAIL with both ratios above 2
assertions.note: Recount of IDR rows 495/1143/233/1680 matches the script; rescue 3.394, self 4.906, verdict FAIL

assertions.text: The ratio/verdict block returns PASS, BORDERLINE (either ratio), FAIL, inf handling and the exactly-2.0 boundary correctly
assertions.note: 7 synthetic IDR-file cases, block extracted from the shipped script; all verdicts as expected

assertions.text: MACS=macs2 (with the env shim) reproduces the MACS3 result
assertions.note: idr/true_reps.idr, reproducibility.txt and conservative.narrowPeak byte-identical; rep1 4,803 peaks in both

assertions.text: The failing-library run completes on its first attempt
assertions.note: samtools merge reported a truncated intermediate BAM (BGZF read error at ~4 MiB) while 3 pipelines ran concurrently on drvfs; identical rerun completed. Not reproduced in 4 other runs; treated as an environment I/O flake

inputs.label: Documented Genrich joint and macs3 hmmratac commands on GM12878
inputs.note: Genrich 14,498 peaks with blacklist, 14,328 without; hmmratac 2,064 regions with model and cutoff files

assertions.text: The usage-guide name-sorted Genrich joint command runs and yields peaks
Coordinate-sorted input aborts as the Skill states
assertions.note: Error: SAM/BAM file not sorted by queryname

assertions.text: The hmmratac command runs and writes the documented outputs
The reconciliation-table Genrich count is reproducible
assertions.note: 14,328 peaks at -q 0.05 without -E reproduces the quoted figure; the blacklist run gives 14,498

inputs.label: Input guards, chrM guard on a synthetic BAM, idxstats chrM-removal recipe
inputs.note: Eight guard cases exit 1 with named errors; chrM guard verified only on a planted 3-read fixture because source BAMs have no chrM reads

assertions.text: Missing genome size, missing argument, missing/unindexed/unsorted BAM, missing blacklist, missing tool and bad chrom.sizes each exit 1 with a specific message
assertions.note: 8 of 8 rc=1, no output directory created for the argument errors

assertions.text: A BAM with chrM reads is refused
assertions.note: Synthetic BAM (3 planted chrM reads, real chrM header): 'has 3 reads on the mitochondrial contig', rc 1

assertions.text: The documented idxstats contig-selection recipe removes chrM reads and keeps header and other reads
assertions.note: Synthetic pair BAM: chr1 pairs kept, chrM reads removed, header kept; a chr1 read whose mate maps to chrM stays as an orphan (see ATACPC-016)

inputs.label: Corrected two-environment install recipe and NFR-only recipe
inputs.note: Both create lines solve; the old bioconda-only line still fails; fresh-environment execution reused from the identity-matched delta pass

assertions.text: Both documented micromamba create lines solve
assertions.note: Dry-run rc 0 each: macs3 3.0.4, Genrich 0.6.2, samtools 1.24, bedtools 2.31.1, bedGraphToBigWig 482; idr 2.0.4.2 with numpy 1.23.5. Delta pass ran real fresh installs and the script in them (reused, same bytes)

assertions.text: The superseded bioconda-only line fails to solve, confirming the correction was needed
assertions.note: dry-run rc 1: macs3 requires hmmlearn conflict

assertions.text: The NFR-only recipe runs and calls peaks
assertions.note: 322,156 short-fragment reads; 10,951 peaks, identical to the initial audit

key_strengths: Pseudoreplicate and Nt/Nself logic now reproduces the ENCODE definitions: disjoint halves (0 shared reads), Nt/N1/N2/Np at one IDR threshold, and correct PASS and FAIL verdicts on a real passing and a genuinely failing library
The corrected two-environment install solves and the superseded one-line install demonstrably does not; MACS2 and MACS3 modes give byte-identical outputs
Input guards fail fast with named errors, and outputs (conservative narrowPeak, pooled bigWig, IDR plots) were inspected and cross-checked against ENCODE peaks and the bedGraph
Genrich and hmmratac commands are now tested and their reconciliation figures reproduce

recommendations.title: Trim description claim of 501bp consensus peaks (ATACPC-015)
recommendations.problem: The description advertises fixing 501bp consensus peaks but the Skill only mentions the Corces re-centering convention and routes to consensus-peakset.
recommendations.fix: Reword to point to atac-seq/consensus-peakset for fixed-width peaks, or state that only re-centering is described.

recommendations.title: ROSE snippet remains unexecuted (ATACPC-012)
recommendations.problem: The ROSE_main.py and GFF conversion are labelled illustrative but were never run because ROSE is not installed.
recommendations.fix: Keep the illustrative label, or execute it in a ROSE environment before dropping the label.

recommendations.title: State orphan-mate behaviour of the chrM recipe (ATACPC-016)
recommendations.problem: The idxstats contig-selection recipe keeps a chr1 read whose mate maps to chrM, leaving a paired-flag orphan that the chrM guard cannot see.
recommendations.root_cause: Selection is by the read's own contig only.
recommendations.fix: Add one sentence, or filter by RNEXT as well, when using BAMPE or hmmratac downstream.
